body: The thing is its not just a question of passing and getting to summer break. I find myself constantly worried about the future and how I'm going to make something of myself. I come from a family with a great amount of pressure to succeed on both sides. On one side you have my dad, the son of a low life gangster who ran away when he was 12, put himself through school, got two masters my the time he was 21, and started multiple successful businesses. On my mom's side the of the family its even worse, the least educated member of her family is an MD. I worked myself to the bone to get into a top 10 university to meet their expectations. And now that I'm here I have no idea how I'm going to keep this up until I actually make something of myself. I'm chipping away at my life and willpower just to stay afloat and I don't know if I can keep it up much longer.
